_meta.title: Verbatim-vendored upstream sources
_meta.notes: Copies ai-kit took from an upstream repo and still ships largely as-is. Only VERBATIM copies belong here — distilled work (the lifecycle skills whose ideas came from mattpocock/skills, gstack, superpowers) is deliberately divergent and must NOT be resynced; see plugins-excluded.json for why. Each entry pins the upstream commit the copy was taken from, so bin/ai-kit-upstream-drift.sh can report when upstream has moved. `local_deltas` records edits ai-kit made on purpose — a re-vendor must reapply them, never clobber them. Field names match the external-rule frontmatter convention documented in VETTING.md.

sources.name: sandcastle-sequential-reviewer
sources.local_deltas: Stack-agnostic patches. main.mts: hardcoded `npm install` and `node_modules` replaced with {{INSTALL_CMD}} / {{COPY_TO_WORKTREE}} placeholders, filled by bin/apply-sandcastle.sh from lockfile detection. implement-prompt.md: `npm run typecheck && npm run test` replaced with project-detected test/lint commands. CODING_STANDARDS.md, review-prompt.md, template.json are byte-identical to the pin.
